# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 59 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 59

Jesus said: "Look upon the Living One while you are alive, lest you die and seek to see him and be unable."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Lest" renders the purpose clause more precisely than "so that you will not"
- "Be unable" — the ellipsis (unable to see) follows the Coptic compression
- "The Living One" capitalized as a divine title
